Players will have to create stylish images, combining the cold shine of snow and the warm glow of the tropics. Help Eliza and Milana become the most fashionable princesses of winter!

Solve each puzzle by moving tiles into the correct order, unlock new categories, collect coins and points, and use helpful bonuses when you need support. The game is easy to play, works on desktop and mobile devices, and offers a calm puzzle experience for players of all ages.

title: Tiles Matching
description:
Free online game Tiles Matching - play in the browser without downloading. It is suitable for the development of logic for both adults and children - an ideal timekiller.
Tiles Matching is a puzzle game combining the game mechanics of Mahjong and Three in a Row (Match-3). A logical educational game for children and adults. With each level, the difficulty increases - not everyone can complete the game the first time. Challenge your intelligence.

title: Egg Farm
description:
Join the egg-citing adventure of Egg Farm and unleash your inner fox as you embark on a fast-paced egg-catching frenzy! 
Dash with lightning agility, master obstacle evasion, and craft a fox character like no other with a range of custom skins. It's time to become an egg-cellent egg-catching maestro - your prowess will earn you legendary status!

title: 2248 Blast
description: Are you ready to train your brain while having fun? 2248 Blast is a highly addictive number-connecting puzzle game designed to relax your mind and sharpen your logic skills! With simple swipe controls and engaging gameplay, this game is perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages.

The wide variety of options for attack and defense make this a highly strategic game with lots of replay value.

Enjoying matching summer tiles with 30 puzzle stages in this game.

title: Legend of Fireball
description:
Fireballs are your weapon of choice as you tap on objects to obliterate them and earn rewards. Every tap brings you closer to becoming the ultimate Fireball King! Collect various fireballs, costumes, and upgrades, enhancing your powers with every victory. Master cool fireball skills to crush objects even faster and more efficiently.
Race against time to demolish all targets in thrilling challenges, proving you're the strongest fireball wielder in the universe!

How big can your Labuba grow?

title: People Playground: Ragdoll Battle
description:
Welcome to People Playground: Ragdoll Battle!
Carefully control your character to strike the right spots on your opponent’s body. Attack strategically to destroy and crush your enemies. Earn gold coins to unlock new characters and upgrade your skills.
Have fun and dominate the arena!

Command an army of miners and warriors to build your forces and triumph over opponents. Upgrade your units and yourself as you gain experience, and strategically attack enemy castles while defending your own. Will your strategy lead you to dominance? Play Stickman Miners Wars now!

title: Card Master

Use special cards and powerful boosts to clear space and score big. With its mix of strategy, challenge, and endless replay value, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves to think ahead and have fun.

title: Italian Brainrot Challenge

description:
Help Obby build up his muscles to escape from the castle!
Swing and get bigger!

The game has a rank system.

Spend cups on eggs, collect all the pets.

description: Battle hordes of Minecraft mobs! Buy awesome swords and helmets, or unbox them from cases. Take on mega-bosses, unlock different modes, and earn leaderboard points to become the best in this game!

title: Supermarket Cashier Simulator
description:
Practice being the best cashier in the supermarket. Become a mathematician by calculating and entering prices of grocery items and giving change to your customers. By playing you also improve your mathematical skills with the calculator in the game. This game is suitable to be played by adults or teenagers.

With the supermarket cashier game, you will improve your skills and concentration in calculating and also increase your level of accuracy.

title: Granny GTA Vegas

With red-hooded masked enemies hot on her trail, she must shoot her way through crime-ridden alleys, casino districts, and the Vegas Strip.

title: Elemental DressUp Magic
description: Welcome to the fascinating world of natural elements and magic! The main characters of the game are already waiting for you - five beautiful girls representing various elements: fire, water, earth and air. The makeup and outfit of each of these girls is inspired by the element that she represents. The fifth heroine is special. This girl is an Avatar that combines all four elements!

title: Solitaire Tail
description: Raise your dragons at Solitaire! Clear the game by moving all cards to the foundation! Move cards from the tableau or stockpile in ascending order of the same suit. In the tableau, you can stack cards in descending order with alternating colors! You can place a King card in an empty column! When there are no available moves, you can draw cards from the stockpile to the foundation or tableau!

title: Ball Mania!
description:
Ball Mania is an addictive little ball runner game. 
You never know what the future holds and a path full of unexpected obstacles awaits your exploration. 
Slide to control the little ball to move left and right, and then turn the corner, you have to be very careful, or you risk falling! 

This is a great test of the player's reaction ability, can you succeed in the challenge?
Simply click the big play button to start having fun.

title: Super Star Animal Salon
description: Welcome to Super Star - Animal Salon, a paws - itively delightful casual simulator game that's perfect for girls with a passion for fashion and animals! In this game, you step into the role of a superstar animal stylist. Your very own salon awaits, filled with all the tools of the trade. First, meet your furry, feathery, or scaly clients. There are cute puppies with a zebra, an elephant, and a leopard. Start with the hair.

Players control a stickman character in a variety of challenging arenas, engaging in battles against other stickmen or AI opponents. The game emphasizes quick reflexes, strategic moves, and a variety of weapons and power-ups to outmaneuver and defeat enemies.

With intuitive controls and a clean interface, Jigsaw Fantasy is great for kids and adults alike.

But beware, each block behaves differently—some will vanish after just one jump, while others can withstand two or more.

title: Race Time

Race through thrilling tracks in your speedy car! Collect gears to charge up your booster and unleash a powerful speed burst.
Upgrade your car to unlock better performance and purchase the fastest vehicles to dominate the competition.
Use the super boost to knock opponents off the track, climb the leaderboard, and prove you're the ultimate racer.
Beat the clock and challenge your friends online!

From small street auctions to luxury halls, build your empire step by step!

As you defeat enemies, you'll find coins that may be used to unlock additional characters with unique abilities.

Open world, stunt modes and fall mode can be played in 1-player and 2-player modes.

Uncover hidden clues and keys to find your way out. In this game, you must carefully examine every detail in the room, searching for hidden clues.

Granny is in a hurry to get home and bake some pies. But there's one problem - first she needs to bake a few hundred zombies! They'll be chasing you in cars and motorcycles, they'll have machine guns, rocket launchers, and support drones. title: Road To 7
description:
Welcome to Road To 7, a fun casual math puzzle for everyone.
Start merging numbers from the starting point along the given path. Calculate adjacent digits with addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. All results must be non-negative integers between 0 and 9.
Finish merging all numbers and get 7 as the final result to clear levels. Sharpen your math and logical thinking in relaxing puzzle gameplay.

Talented writers and actors created this story and brought its characters to life. Enjoy the story!

Create unique sports looks: from elegant dresses for the opening ceremony to uniforms for training. Mix colors, accessories and shoes to make each monstro-athlete shine in her own way. The Lunar League is waiting for its champions!

title: Snowflight

Various game modes await you: explore the world, search for hidden items, and take part in thrilling competitions. title: Big Block Blast

Place triangles and blocks to build 2x2 BIG BLOCKS! Drag and drop shapes into the grid to complete full squares made of triangles. Matching colors gives you bonus points, so in Big Block Blast you must aim for smart and colorful combos!
Some blocks have special powers and can even be placed on top of others. Use them strategically to unlock new moves and clear space. Big Block Blast is a simple to play game but tricky to master! How many BIG BLOCKS can you make?

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake

You are the owner of the pet store! Earn as much money as possible, satisfy all visitors! Try to catch all the animals!
This is an easy and relaxing game in which you are the owner of a pet store!

Grow food, feed animals, build new enclosures, sell animals to buyers. Your goal is to earn as much money as possible, for this try to grow and sell as many animals as possible.

Help Santa spread Christmas joy across the globe!
Tap to generate gifts, merge identical items to craft new toys, and fulfill children’s wishes to raise each country’s happiness. Travel from snowy towns to sunny beaches, unlocking new festive destinations. Merge, match, and make magic — the more joy you spread, the closer Santa gets to completing his world tour!

title: Sand Blast - Block Game
description:
Welcome to Sand Blast, a fresh and relaxing twist on classic block puzzle games!
Relax your mind with Sand Blast — a satisfying and strategic puzzle game built around flowing sand mechanics.
Whether you're into relaxing brain games, casual offline fun, or smart logic challenges, Sand Blast delivers a fresh experience you can enjoy anytime, anywhere — no WiFi or internet required.

title: Draw To Home 3D
description:
Draw to home is a game to draw lines home. Everyone needs to return home according to their respective homes. This type of puzzle game is full of adventure with avoiding traps and obstacles on the way to finding a house.

Play a game of drawing a line to get home. It is very fun for children or teenagers to fill their days with this fun game.

title: GT Championship Arcade
description: Get ready to ignite your engines and experience the ultimate rush of speed in GT Championship Arcade! This fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled racing game brings the excitement of GT racing into a visually stunning, arcade-style world filled with neon-lit tracks, intense rivalries, and heart-pounding action. Whether you’re a casual gamer looking for quick thrills or a hardcore racing fan seeking the ultimate challenge, this game offers an electrifying experience like no other.

title: Gas Station - Stick Simulator
description: You start with a small gas station in the middle of the highway, where everything depends on you. Service cars, fill up with gas, earn coins, and build even bigger! Over time, your gas station will grow into a true empire: with a store, restroom, cafe, and even a hot dog delivery service. The more customers, the more profit, upgrades, and fun!

title: StickMan Gunner
description: StickMan Gunner is a fast-paced running game that puts players in control of a powerful gun zipping through levels. You guide it to pick up stickmen along the way, building up your crew while smashing through obstacles and enemies that pop up. It’s straightforward gameplay that keeps things moving without much downtime, making it a solid pick for short sessions during study breaks or downtime.

title: Mermaidcore Aesthetics
description: In Mermaidcore Aesthetics, you'll embark on a thrilling undersea adventure alongside three fabulous fashionistas. Each mermaid has a unique and stunning wardrobe that will make your inner fashionista do a happy dance! With a wide selection of clothing options and accessories available at your disposal, you'll have endless possibilities to create your fashionable mermaid looks. Have a blast!

title: Break Beat
description: Break Beat is a fast-paced and colorful brick-breaker game with a pixel art/neon aesthetic and an electronic music soundtrack.

title: Guess The Italian Brainrot Animals
description: Get ready for a wild and hilarious ride with Guess the Italian Brainrot Animals, a fast-paced, emoji-fueled trivia game that tests your knowledge of 64 iconic Italian Brainrot characters! From the most famous to the obscure, this game challenges you to guess the correct character based on three emoji clues before the timer runs out. Think you’re a Brainrot expert? Prove it!

title: Hero Transform Run
description: Superheroes accumulate energy by constantly upgrading themselves, and at the end of the level they must quickly defeat different enemies. This is a casual combat parkour game!

title: Digital Circus Find The Differences
description:
Step into the whimsical and wacky world of Digital Circus: Find The Differences, where fun meets challenge! Explore vibrant and surreal circus scenes filled with unique characters and zany details, all while sharpening your observation skills. Can you spot the subtle changes between two seemingly identical pictures?
Put your eyes to the test and discover how many differences you can find in this exciting puzzle adventure!

title: Mr. Drifter: Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, and EMP Blasts to escape the impossible.

Unlock wild getaway cars
⚡ Grab power-ups mid-chase
 Smash through obstacles & roadblocks
Stylized low-poly world with top-down tilt
Endless cops. Infinite chaos.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: Monster Slayer Merge & Survive
description: Welcome to our thrilling adventure game! Your journey consists of two main parts: merging items and exploring dungeons. Embark on this epic journey, combine powerful items, and conquer the depths of the dungeon!

title: Love Tile Trio
description: Welcome to the Valentine's Day tile matching game! Your mission is to match and clear tiles from the board. Tap a tile and move it to an empty space or a spot with a matching tile. If no matches are available or there's no room, you'll need to try again. With a countdown timer and tricky puzzles, can you beat the Love Tile challenge?

title: Dictator Simulator: 1984
description: Make choices as the Supreme Leader of a dystopian state. Maintain control, balance resources, and crush opposition—or be overthrown!

title: Toy Cars: 3D Racing
description: Jump into the car and participate in this racing experience. Compete with other racers, participate in various challenges and time-limited events. Prepare your car and drift. Upgrade your carriage. The engine, tires and chassis improve the overall performance of your car.

title: Epic Racing - Descent on Cars
description:
To tear yourself and your neighbor to shreds, but to reach the finish line first is an "Epic Racing - Descent on Cars"!

Epic collisions, a serious fight to the finish line and a million ways to bend and twist metal - that's what awaits you in the game "Epic Racing - Descent on Cars".

Burn rubber and tear metal - the game begins!

title: Max Speed
description: Race shiny sports cars on thrilling 3D tracks full of jumps, stunts, and intense battles. Explore exciting locations with unique challenges, perform daring tricks, upgrade and customize your cars, and test your skills in fast-paced arcade races. Enjoy high-speed action, stunning visuals, and nonstop adrenaline right in your browser.

title: Crystal Connect
description: Discover the enchanting world of Crystal Connect, a captivating game with breathtaking graphics! Join a pair of dwarves on an epic quest to collect precious crystals and navigate through dozens of challenging levels in this immersive connect-style adventure game. Connect pairs of gems, create powerful combinations and pave your way to victory. Dive into the adventure today and discover the magic of Crystal Connect

title: Number Merge 10
description: Number Merge 10 is a very innovative math puzzle game.Select a rectangular area, and if the sum of the numbers within that area equals 10, all the numbers in that area will be eliminated!

title: Racing Pinball
description:
"Racing Pinball" is a fast-paced arcade game that brings the timeless thrill of pinball to your device!
Launch the ball into action and use flippers to keep it in play, racking up points by hitting bumpers, targets, and ramps.
"Racing Pinball" needs skill and reflexes in a classic, addictive experience where the goal is simple: keep the ball rolling and aim for the high score!

title: Hungry Corgi - Cute Music Game
description: Hungry Corgi is a music game where you feed the dog to music and try to catch the rhythm of the cutest songs created especially for this game. A perfect way to relax and have fun playing the cutest while also challenging rhythm game. Join to corgi adventure to meet new friends by opening characters, listen to fun songs and unlock incredible themes that change everything!

title: Frog Knight
description: Frog Bubble your mission is to help a spirited frog pop an array of mischievous bubbles! Using your swift reflexes and strategic skills, you’ll throw your lily pad-shaped projectiles at bubbles to clear each level.

title: Gun Rush
description: Begin an action-packed gun battle runner. Gun Rush is an electrifying arcade game that combines gun merging with platform running. Run forward, avoid obstacles, collect weapons, and blast your way to the finish line with ultimate firepower. Control the direction of your gun, shooting power, ATK speed, and Range to increase its value. Increase your damage by using high-value doors.

title: Tung Sahur Bots Chase Room
description:
Horror brainrot bots are on the hunt! Watch out, stay alive!

Welcome to Tung Sahur Bots Chase Room – the ultimate brainrot meme horror escape game!

Get ready for heart-pounding chases as you find yourself trapped in backroom full of unpredictable Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala Bots and other viral meme creatures. Can you keep up with the chaos, dodge the brainrot traps, and make it out alive? Only the fastest runners will escape this nightmare.

title: Ping Pong Air
description: Table tennis, also known as ping pong, is an easy and enjoyable arcade game in which you control the bat as simply as in life: with the mouse or the movement of your finger. Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

title: Hawaii Match 6
description: Escape to paradise in Hawaii Match 6! Explore beautiful island landscapes while matching exotic fruits, flowers, and tropical treasures. Complete fun and challenging goals in limited moves by combining symbols and creating powerful bonuses. Unlock helpful boosters, discover hidden rewards, and enjoy a relaxing island adventure full of colorful puzzles. Play Hawaii Match 6 now and enjoy endless tropical fun!

title: Asylum: Baldi Granny Slender
description: You'll be heading into the forest to find a mental hospital. Legend has it that this mental hospital is where rare Brainrot figurines are found. Characters like Baldi, Granny, and Slenderman guard these figurines. A bipedal deer also lives in the forest, so be careful not to fall into their clutches! You can hide under beds in the mental hospital to avoid being caught by the monsters.

title: Turbo Stars
description:
Hop on your skateboard and speed down the track in this wild and fast-paced racing game!

Zoom through a wide variety of exhilarating tracks and defeat your opponents!

Think fast to pick up items that will help you gain an advantage — or even pick up and throw your competitors if they get too close to you! 

Don’t forget to snatch coins and keys to unlock a whole bunch of awesome items, including power-ups, new objects to ride on, and gear for your character.

title: Cat Evolution
description:
Embark on a paws-itively thrilling journey of discovery and creativity in Cat Evolution! Combine adorable cats to unlock hilarious and surprising new species. From cuddly kittens to fantastical hybrids, every merge brings you closer to unveiling the ultimate evolution.

Merge & Unlock Cats Evolutions. 
Build Your Cat Universe!

title: Bunnys Farm
description: Embark on a delightful fruit match-3 adventure with Bunny's Farm: Zen Match Master. Join your cheerful companion, Bunny, as you traverse diverse landscapes—from lush meadows and snowy peaks to desert dunes and tropical beaches. Match juicy fruits like oranges and peaches to solve engaging puzzles, uncover enchanting stories, and unlock new chapters in this relaxing yet challenging journey.

title: Bingo Halloween
description: A Halloween-themed bingo game where you can win exciting bingos to unlock spooky candy-themed images. Enjoy multiple call speeds and progressive unlocks.

title: Secrets of Charmland
description:
● Unique gameplay: help Emma treat her friends by swapping and matching delicious sweets!
● Tons of match-3 levels filled with exciting elements, awesome boosters and explosive combinations!
● A world full of Charmland: discover all the magical places it has to offer!
● Fantastic characters: watch Emma making new acquaintances and helping them with their unusual quests.

title: Planet Hopper
description: Use your ship to navigate and jump between different planets across the galaxy, but be careful not to drift off into the vastness of outer space!

title: Excavator Simulator 3D
description: Drive and operate realistic 3D construction vehicles in Excavator Simulator 3D. You can choose from different trucks, excavators, and Pincer Jaws to complete various missions and tasks. Whether you need to dig, clamp, lift, hammer, or forklift, you can switch the attachments easily and quickly. Learn how to control these powerful machines and enjoy the realistic physics and graphics. Complete the levels faster and earn more money to buy more vehicles and unlock new challenges. Have fun!

title: Nuts & Bolts Sort: Color Puzzle
description: Play Color Sort Puzzle: Nuts & Bolts free online and challenge your mind in a clever browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Unscrew, swap, and organize bolts by color in a satisfying logic puzzle that works as a focused brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart, addictive sorting fun anytime.

title: Dino Shooter Pro
description: Dino Shooter Pro is an exciting gun battle game. You are on an island. There are many dinosaurs and bad guys on this island. They are extremely ferocious and attack everyone they see. Your weapon is a gun. When there are dinosaurs and bad guys around you, pick up your gun, aim at the opponent, and fire bullets in rapid succession.  Try to kill all of them, good luck!

title: The White Room 5
description: The White Room 5 is the fifth sequel of an adventure escape game with a cartoon art style. Find objects that can help you escape the room and use your logic to solve the puzzles. Good luck!

title: Push The Frog
description: Control your little frog to eat all the mosquitoes. Master the length of the frog's tongue and make the frog reach the appropriate position to eat the mosquitoes. Think carefully about planning the route. The game has a simple and interesting style, and the gameplay is educational and novel. It is very suitable for playing when killing time.

title: Emoji Smasher - Smiley Game
description:
Emoji Smasher is a Hyper Casual game to make you smile while playing!
Guess the emoticon expressions in this fast-paced challenge! Tap on emojis and win this lively, emoji-filled adventure.

title: Harvesting Veggies
description: Players will take on the role of a farmer, planting vegetables and achieving a full row or column to harvest. The game is based on a cartoon style, with a fresh and cute overall aesthetic, making it fun and addictive to play.

title: Save little red hood
description:
Match-3 puzzles combined with physics-based gameplay: eliminate blocks to make stones fall and become Little Red Riding Hood's weapons, which she then uses to attack the wolf.
Plan your elimination route carefully, utilizing gravity to make the stones fall and become weapons—that's the ultimate goal. Various power-ups can also help you.

title: Flower Block
description: Dive into our unique COMBO gameplay, where you strategically place blocks to clear rows or columns. Watch as clearing multiple lines triggers exciting animations and earns you bonus points. Challenge your mind and plan your moves wisely to ace Flower Block!

title: Archer Legend
description: Play Archery Battle Legend, the ultimate bow and arrow game! Test your aim in exciting archery battles, shoot targets, and defeat enemies like a true archer hero. Perfect for US students searching “archery game,” “stickman archer,” or “cool math games bow and arrow,” this free online challenge mixes skill, action, and fun. With endless levels, epic duels, and fast arrow shooting, sharpen your skills and become the legendary archer everyone talks about!

title: Ducklings
description: Ducklings is a fun .io game where you rescue all the ducklings from the dangers of aquatic life. Dangers like reckless boat drivers that'll row into you and end your objectives early.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Pet Connect Match
description: Pet Connect Match is an interesting matching game, in this game, you need to connect the same pets to eliminate all of them.  There are many different modes you can choose, you can pass levels, challenge time mode or just play without any limit. Have a good time!

title: Ladder Master - Color Run
description:
Run and collect ladder parts, grow your ladder, reach the moon!
Fun and addictive runner game for one player!
Can you make the highest ladder? Check out now!

title: SNAKES
description: SNAKES is a modern puzzle game that combines strategy and spatial reasoning. Players guide multiple snakes across a grid, filling every empty tile to complete each level. With clear visuals and intuitive mechanics, the game offers a relaxing yet challenging experience that sharpens logical thinking. Each level introduces unique layouts and obstacles, ensuring variety and depth as players advance.

title: Dynamons 11
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 11! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Guardian Island world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Chyroax, Scorvenox, Axolotix, Uryndur, Skyvioru, Golunaryx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: BFFs K-Pop Fangirls
description: BFFs K-pop Fangirls is a casual dress-up game where you can be the ultimate fangirl and flaunt your styling skills! You get to dress four fabulous and fashionable women ready to start their evening of K-pop fun.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Crush the Eggs
description: In this game, eggs have appeared that you will have to fight with and break. In front of you on the screen you will see a platform on which the egg will be located. Above it you will see a special field. Using the mouse you can draw any object on it. When you finish your actions, this item will fall directly onto the egg. If your calculations are correct, then you will break it and thus destroy it. After this you will move to the next level of the game.

title: Cake Link Master
description: Cake Link Master is a fun puzzle game where you tap two matching cakes to connect them with a line. The line can turn up to two times but cannot go over other tiles. The game has 120 challenging levels, and the difficulty grows as you play. Clear the cakes, solve the puzzles, and enjoy hours of sweet, relaxing fun!

title: Kingdom match
description: Kingdom match is a competitive match-3 game with castle decoration options! Complete levels, compete with other players and build the best castle!

title: Giant Wanted Monster
description: The city is being occupied by giant monsters. You, as an elite sniper, pick up your sniper gun. Defeat these crazy monsters and protect the survival of humanity. In Giant Wanted Monster, the fate of the city is at stake with every bullet. You need to use the powerful sniper weapon to shoot accurately from a distance and hit the monster's Achilles heel.

title: Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon
description: Welcome to Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon! Do you dream of owning your own movie theater empire? Now's your chance! In this super fun idle simulation management game, you'll start with a small screening room! Build your own cinema empire! As a theater owner, you need to manage every aspect of the theater. Unlock the theater's facilities, ticket booths, movie halls, dining areas, and more. Hiring employees to help you get more bang for your buck.

title: Geometry Dash Jump
description: Get ready for an electrifying challenge in Geometry Dash Jump Test your reflexes and timing as you jump, fly, and dash through neon-lit obstacles in a world of glowing geometry. With fast-paced action, rhythmic music, and intense gameplay, this game will push your skills to the limit!

title: Football Penalty
description: Step into an exhilarating, never-ending penalty challenge! Show your opponents the power of your accurate shots and become a real football hero. Collect points for every target hit, progress through levels, and improve your football skills. Take part in a big tournament and get more rewards.

title: Classic Labyrinth 3d Maze
description:
Classic Labyrinth 3d - The wooden maze funny game with the steel ball everyone knows comes to your browser! Enjoy this classic marble maze labyrinth.  
     
Features:
- Accurate ball physic simulation
- Joystick Controler
- Smooth ball movement
- Personal highscores
- 3 Star rating system
- One coin per 3 Star finished level
- Realistic sounds
- Coins to continue, if you fail during the level.

title: IDLE Pet
description: Anatomical clicker. Start with one cell and create a whole animal! You will see what the body is made of from the inside, gradually growing bones, organs, skin and wool!

title: Block Puzzle Tropical Story
description: Discover a new genre in the world of puzzles! This game intertwines block puzzles with a thrilling adventure on tropical islands! Complete levels to earn stars, unlock new territories and unique relaxation areas. From snow-white beaches to dense jungles – each location is filled with unique challenges. The booster system will help you in difficult situations, and the well-thought-out mechanics allow both beginners and experienced players to enjoy the game.

title: Slinky Color Sort
description: Slinky Color Sort Puzzle is a relaxing color-therapy game where you sort bright slinky rings into matching stacks. Easy to play yet surprisingly challenging, it’s perfect for calming down while keeping your brain active. Enjoy smooth gameplay, colorful levels, and satisfying logic puzzles.

title: PopSortica
description:
PopSortica is a new chapter in Poppy’s adventures! Join the underwater SORTING voyage! Challenging yet relaxing levels await as you sort things out.
The rules are simple, but the difficulty increases with each new level.
Special obstacles and conditions will challenge your skills, while boosters will help you achieve the best results faster.
Dive deep with Mermaid Poppy and challenge yourself in this exciting sea sorting adventure!

title: Obby Pinata Party
description: Help the Obby guy to fight those pinatas and Explore the world. Choose from wide variety of weapons, collect coins and upgrade them. Make the pinatas give you every penny they have!

title: Bomb Head Hot Potato
description:
In the game "Bomb Head - Hot Potato" your goal is to stay alive and not die from the bomb in your hand. Drop bombs on your opponents to win! 
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of "Bomb Head - Hot Potato" and prove your survival skills and tactical thinking!

title: Stickman Zombie vs Stickman Hero
description:
Stickman Zombie vs Stickman Hero is a stick war game about zombies, stickman, noob and pro who stole lucky block. The zombie boss is chasing them to bring the lucky block back to the roblox world, but the stickman hero escapes, resurrecting his allies along the way/

Game Features:
- You run away from the zombie boss and then play as him against the animator
- Various zombie, baldi and stickman animations
- The game is similar in style to minecraft, stick war, roblox and noob vs p

title: ASMR Pet Treatment
description: Take care of your adorable puppy and kitty in this relaxing ASMR game! Wash, heal, and pamper your pets with gentle treatments. After they feel happy and healthy, have fun dressing them up in cute outfits. Relaxing sounds and sweet pets make every moment enjoyable!

title: Hotel Fever Tycoon
description: Wanna be a Hotel Empire Tycoon or a Top Cooking Chef? Come to "Hotel Fever Tycoon" to start an interesting hotel management and cooking journey with Emma and Uncle George! Work together to build your world-class hotel chain!

title: Telekinesis Attack
description: Use your telekinesis magic power! Gain the ability to control the power of thought! Throw your enemies wherever you want, hit them against whatever you want and deal with them however you want! Using your unique power, defeat all enemies, interact with different objects, take away weapons from enemies and be the strongest!

title: Merge cubes 2048 3D
description: A completely new approach to the classic game 2048?! Now in 3D and with dynamic physics?! Number cubes don't just merge - they bounce and collide?, adding an element of surprise to every game! Compete with friends or colleagues?!

title: Horror Hotel: Scary Room
description:
"Horror Room" is a simulator of the owner of a theme park, where visitors come to experience thrills. The player will have to develop his establishment, improving the rooms of fear, buying new decorations and equipment, as well as hiring actors and staff. The goal of the game is to scare as many visitors as possible and make their stay in the park unforgettable.

Scare all your customers!
Buy new creepy rooms!
Monitor the condition of the rooms, clean, repair the equipment.

title: Dark Myth: Monkey Merge
description: Merge warriors, build your army, and fight through hordes of monsters as the Monkey King! Your master and companions have been captured — combine strategy and action to rescue them all. From Common to Legendary, every merge makes you stronger.

title: Sort Master
description: Get ready to bring order to the chaos in Sort Master, a relaxing yet addictive online puzzle game. Test your logic and observation skills as you sort, match, and organize a variety of fun challenges — from colors to everyday objects. Whether you’re playing on your phone or computer, enjoy the satisfying feeling of tidying up and completing each level with perfection. Play for free and become the ultimate Sort Master!

title: Labubu Merge
description:
Engage, Merge, and Challenge!
Dive into a labubu-matching journey where you collide identical labubu to evolve them and keep them from falling out of the box. But here's the twist: when the same labubus collide, they transform into an entirely new labubu. Can you merge your way to the grand labubu?

title: Worm Puzzle Snake Apple
description: Worm Puzzle: Snake Apple combines classic snake gameplay with creative puzzle challenges. You solve spatial problems, escape traps, and guide snakes through clever levels. With funny snake movements and playful interactions, it brings a strong Funny vibe while still offering smart puzzle challenges. Fans of casual games enjoy its relaxing pace, while puzzle lovers enjoy the deep puzzle design. It also offers a calming relaxation flow with surprising twists in every level.

title: Maze Craze
description: Step into the captivating world of Maze Craze, a puzzle game that combines creativity, humor, and strategic problem-solving. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers, Maze Craze offers an endless journey through a variety of mazes, each with its own unique set of challenges and surprises.

title: Oil Tanker Transport Truck
description: Let's go on to ride with an oil tanker transporter truck across all the continents like the Euro, Asia, and America oil transporter truck game has real features in the Euro and American cargo systems of the fuel truck.

title: Chicken Banana Run
description: Explore the World and Space with the famous Chicken Banana! Run and keep running to collect gold, diamonds and special items and finish with the longest distance to get a high score! Play now the new free runner game for everyone.

title: Ants Party
description: Welcome to Ants Party — a charming strategy-idle game where your colony's mission is clear: eat it all! On each level, a delicious item appears — from juicy apples to giant cakes — and your ants must devour it completely. Starting from your anthill, they march out, take a bite, and carry the piece back home. The level ends when the entire treat is consumed and hauled away.

title: Toilet Roll
description: Remember the fun of unrolling toilet paper as a kid? Now relive that joy in a fast-paced game. Unwind as many rolls as you can in one minute, but be careful not to tear the paper—it costs valuable time. Earn points for upgrades. Play Toilet Roll for free and let your inner child loose!

title: Monster Squad Rush
description:
Assemble your squad of powerful monsters, evolve them into champions, and claim victory in the ultimate battle arena. Adventure, strategy, and competition await!

Whether you’re rushing through the course, collecting monsters, or battling for supremacy, Monster Squad Rush offers non-stop action and fun. Build your legacy as the ultimate monster trainer and conquer the arena today!

title: The Stone Miner
description: Become the ultimate mining tycoon in The Stone Miner! Drive your powerful mining machine through various fantasy terrains. Crush, collect and smash stones like never before! Steer your mine cart through rocks of different colors and materials and enjoy the exhilarating experience of stone mining. Sell collected stones for gold, and unlock new areas full of rare materials and surprises! Upgrade your vehicle to mine faster and deeper, turning your gear into a true beast!

title: Hidden Object: Emily's Case
description:
A detective adventure set in Victorian London.

Search for hidden objects, uncover clues, and investigate the disappearance of a young girl. Solve puzzles, play mini-games, and step by step reveal the secrets of the old city.

title: Everything is in place: Rare finds
description:
Welcome to a peaceful haven for everyone who loves aesthetics and perfectionism! If you find genuine joy in perfect symmetry, neatly organized items, and pristine spaces, this meditative puzzle game is designed specifically for you.
You will step into the shoes of not just an organizer, but a true connoisseur of beauty. Each level presents a new, unique location cluttered with a variety of intriguing objects.

title: Match Find 3D
description:
Are you a master player of finding games?Do you enjoy matching puzzle games?Come to challenge this addictive puzzle game - Match Find 3D!
Unique gameplay, a combination of collecting and matching, and well-designed levels that will keep you entertained.

title: Italian Brainrot Quiz
description: Italian Brainrot Quiz is a chaotic meme-guessing game where you match bizarre names to iconic brainrot characters! From Tralalero Tralala to Bombardiro Crocodilo and Tung Tung Tung Sahur – can you guess them all? Each round is a wild ride through surreal Italian meme culture. Laugh, confuse your friends, and become the ultimate Brainrot Champion. Spaghetti logic guaranteed. Ready to play?

title: Unpuzzle Master
description:
Unpuzzle master plan and execute your moves strategically to become the master, navigating through bottlenecks and utilizing “exit” strategies effectively.

Touch the tile to move it in the direction of the tile. Complete each level that really challenges your brain to think sharper.

Choose from a variety of themes and skins to customize your block-puzzle adventure. Each skin not only changes the visual aesthetic but also improves the way you interact with the puzzles, making every move count.

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online game takes the familiar lucky box idea and turns it into a more active risk-and-return loop. You move through 14 areas, open boxes, collect brainrots, and decide whether to head back safely or keep pushing for rarer finds. Online play is available through 1 Player mode, while local 2-player adds a same-screen option for faster, more chaotic sessions. Rebirth, speed upgrades, better boxes, base expansion, and roaming bosses keep every run moving forward.

title: Idle Landmark Builder
description: Enjoy a casual idle simulation management game in the Idle Landmark - Builder. Here, you'll play the role of a construction tycoon and build world-famous landmarks from scratch. Manage workers to increase speed or your income, hire more workers and build your own construction empire. Build world-famous landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the Pyramids, and witness the entire process of their construction.

title: Real Car Parking And Stunt
description: Welcome to Real Car Parking And Stunt, a challenging driving simulation game. Here you’ll control a car and put your parking and stunt skills to the test. Choose stunt mode or parking mode, each level challenges you to park your car accurately while performing exciting stunts.

title: Mojo Emoji
description: Moji Emoji is a fun and clever word/emoji puzzle game where each level challenges you to guess the hidden word or phrase from a set of expressive emojis. Think fast, connect the clues, and test your emoji decoding skills across hundreds of creative puzzles.

title: Little Candy Bakery
description:
Little candy bakery is a puzzle match 3 game, bake the candy and match candies together to win. The game theme is calm and entertaining. Players can use power-ups such as rockets bombs and marmalades to bake faster and collect more candy. 
You can challenge your friends and see who can score higher.
Little candy bakery is free to play candy puzzle game
Have fun playing Little candy bakery sweetest match 3 puzzle game around!

title: Urban Assault Force
description: Step into the boots of an elite counter-terrorism unit in Urban Assault Force, an intense first-person shooter that plunges you into the heart of urban warfare. The city is under siege by a ruthless terrorist group, and it's up to you and your team to strike back and save the day.

title: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up
description:
In Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up, you’re dressing up your doll and getting her ready to go live. Pick from different styles—she can look like a fairy, wear chill street clothes, or go for a beach outfit. When you’re done, she jumps on the stream and starts showing off her look.

You can mess with her hair, add makeup, and try out accessories. There’s also a battle mode where you go up against other players to see who styled it best.

title: Cozy Garden Idle
description: Unwind with this soothing and adorable place. Reveal, pick, and nurture attractive plants to extend your garden and provide more oxygen!

title: Make America Great Again
description: Take control of a powerful character in the center of the ring, facing waves of wrestlers charging from the right. Your reflexes will be tested as you press directional buttons to deliver well-timed punches and knock out the incoming opponents. As you progress, you'll unlock special abilities that temporarily increase the strength of your punches, allowing you to knock out multiple enemies in a line with a single powerful blow.

title: Aidan in Danger
description: Aidan in Danger is an exciting platformer where you play as Aidan, a young red-haired elf armed with a slingshot. Your mission is to protect Drakor, the last dragon on Earth, from an interdimensional villain bent on world domination. Battle dangerous monsters, travel through time, and navigate challenging levels in this epic adventure. With immersive gameplay, stunning graphics, and a gripping story, help Aidan save Drakor and restore peace to the land!

title: Erase the extra element
description: Sharpen your focus and logic in Erase the Extra Element! Erase parts of each scene to reveal clues and solve tricky visual puzzles.

title: Draw To Smash!
description:
Draw To Smash — a logic puzzle game in which you should draw a line, scribbles, figures or doodles to smash all the bad eggs.

Draw To Smash is an amusing logic game that will test your IQ and raise your intellectual abilities to a new level. Plan every step, estimate a possible outcome and build tactical strategies. Solve logical puzzles, pass interesting levels and open bonus levels.

title: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle
description: Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a soothing thread-sorting challenge that blends creativity with logic. Organize colorful yarns across tricky boards, using boosters like the Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom when levels get tough. Customize your setup with extra slots and boxes, and enjoy calm, vibrant visuals. With progressively harder puzzles, it’s both relaxing and rewarding for sorting and puzzle fans alike.

title: Stunt Car Extreme 2
description: Experience the exhilarating thrill of Stunt automobile Extreme 2, a remarkable 3D game that offers free access. Engage in extreme automobile driving on very challenging courses, which include moving platforms suspended in the sky. Navigate over intense obstacles and sharp bends to test your skills to the limit.

title: MiniGiants.io
description: MiniGiants.io is a top-down multiplayer deathmatch IO game. Take control of your own MiniGiant and battle other players for rewards.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Capybara Block Drop
description:
Capybara Block Drop is a fast-paced, brain-teasing puzzle game where merging numbers and staying calm under pressure is the key to survival.

Drop numbered blocks into columns, combine matching tiles, and clear space with big combos.
But watch out, if the board fills up, it’s game over, and your capybara buddy might just lose his cool!

With colorful visuals and satisfying number-merging mechanics, Capybara Block Drop delivers endless strategic fun wrapped in a charming, lighthearted package.

title: Fidget Toys Pop It
description: Fidget Toys Pop It is a free online relaxing and puzzle game for boys played on PuzzleGame. It contains many sensory fidget toys collected by ASMR sound at the satisfying sound. Complete all kinds of puzzles, and release the pressure by clicking and pressing. The game has many shapes like a dinosaur, flower, cactus, heart, etc. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable.

title: Fruit Cafe: Match 3
description:
Fruit Cafe: Match is a cozy meditative puzzle that blends the best of Mahjong and Match . Wind down after a long day to soothing music, match juicy fruit tiles and clear levels at your own pace.
Highlights:
• Over unique levels — from quick warm-ups to proper brainteasers
• boosters for any situation — they keep you out of dead ends or pull you out of one
• Adaptive difficulty — after a losing streak, the difficulty lowers by one level to match your pace

title: Stickman Archero Fight: stick shadow fight war
description:
Complete levels, collecting items that you can then put on yourself and improve in your inventory. You can finish off your enemies with colorful fatalities. Try different skill combinations to complete as many levels as possible. 
Game features:

- Fights with stickmen
- Skins: warrior, fighter, ninja
- Enemies: red stickman, black stickman
- Various biomes

Did you like the game "Stickman Archero Fight: stick shadow fight war"? - Then write a review and play all our games about stickmen.

title: Tank Challenge
description:
Tank Challenge is an action-packed tank battle game that tests your reflexes and strategy. Play solo or challenge a friend in fast-paced matches.

Defeat your opponent using powerful weapons like lasers, triple bullets, bomb shells, and rockets.

Make quick decisions, aim carefully, and stay ahead to win. Smooth on mobile and desktop, easy to learn but challenging to master.

Enter the arena and fight for victory!

title: Popcat Clicker
description:
Popcat Clicker is a fun idle clicker game where you tap a cute cat to earn coins, unlock upgrades, boost your income, and progress through different levels. 
The more you tap, the faster your cat grows and the more rewards you earn.
Simple, addictive and perfect for all ages!

title: Worms
description: Worms is a fun and addictive arcade puzzle where you control a cute worm and guide it through winding labyrinths. Your task is to lead the worm through the entire maze, collect rewards, use portals and avoid dead ends. Bright cartoon-style graphics and easy controls make the game perfect for both kids and adults. Worms combines fast arcade action with puzzle-solving logic, turning every new level into a fresh and exciting challenge.

title: Obby: Pogo Parkour!
description: Obby: Pogo Parkour! is a dynamic arcade game where you control a character on a pogo stick, overcoming various levels filled with obstacles. Buy and upgrade your pogo sticks to complete challenges faster and more efficiently. Compete with players from all around the world and aim for the top of the leaderboard. Dive into the thrilling world of parkour on a pogo stick and test your reflexes in Obby: Pogo Parkour!

title: Basket Swap
description: Slide into the gray blocks to help you position the ball and grid correctly. If you're stuck, click on the arrow in the bottom left corner to undo your last move, or press R to restart the level.

title: Stick War Saga
description: Prepare for an epic clash in Stick War: Saga, an exciting blend of fighting, action, strategy, and tower defense. Take command of your stickman army and lead them through nervous war campaigns. Mine resources, build your army, and unleash your strategic power to conquer enemy lands.

title: Little Dentist Dash
description: Little Dental Dash is a charming clinic management where you step into the role of a friendly dentist helping kids with their dental problems. From fixing chipped teeth to carefully placing braces, each patient brings a new challenge that tests your speed and attention to detail. Treat your young patients, keep them smiling, and earn rewards for your excellent work.

title: Stickman Dismount Simulator
description:
Stickman physics simulation. Use the turbo to smash him into barriers and traps.

Stickman Dismount: The hottest stunt action game of 2022. You will perform stunts through all the oncoming obstacles to break as many stickman bones as you can.

title: Barbiecore Aesthetics
description: Step into a whimsical world of pastel dreams and retro vibes with the Barbiecore Aesthetics dress-up game! Test your fashionista skills as you mix and match vibrant colors, fluffy textures, and vintage-inspired patterns to create the most stunning doll-like outfits. From quirky accessories to flouncy dresses, this game offers endless possibilities to express your style. Embrace the Barbiecore trend and let your creativity soar as you curate the perfect wardrobe for our beloved fashion icon.

title: Halloween Challenge
description: Get ready for a spooky adventure in Halloween Challenge! Bats are flying through the night, carrying candy that you must protect. Your mission? Tap the bats before they escape with the sweet treats. But beware, if even one bat escapes, the game is over! With simple controls and addictive gameplay, Halloween Challenge offers a fun and fast-paced experience for players. Test your reflexes, compete for high scores, and enjoy the eerie Halloween atmosphere. How long can you defend the candy?

title: Build A Queen 2025
description: In Build a Queen 2025, you will embark on a fun journey to become a real queen. You will need to make your way through different platform levels with your opponents. Choose outfits, skin colors, and more according to your goals. Dress up in the most glamorous queen look, meet the prince, and win. You can collect money to unlock more dance steps.

title: Solitaire Emperor - Secrets of Fate
description:
Enter the magical world of Tarot in this captivating solitaire adventure! Each card tells a story, and every level presents a new puzzle. Meet iconic Tarot characters like the wise Hermit and bold Knight of Swords as they guide your journey.
A dark sorcerer threatens to unravel the Arcana's magic—only you can uncover its secrets, solve riddles, and restore balance. Will your intuition and strategy save this mystical realm?

title: Pesky Moles
description:
An ordinary farmer lived a quiet life and grew vegetables, but at some point, moles began to attack his garden and eat the entire crop.
After the next harvest, he decides to take everything into his own hands and protect his garden.
In Pesky Moles, you have to protect your garden from moles for a certain amount of time. The more pests you manage to neutralize and the more crops you save, the more coins you get. With the coins you earn, you can buy traps that will help you protect your garden.

title: Ball Tower of Hell
description: Ball in hell rolling his way to the top of the tower. There are many difficulties on the way, but the brave ball not scared

title: Palkovil The Way Home
description: Explore the magical world of Palkovil! Battle monsters, solve puzzles, collect toys, and uncover secrets. Feed pets, defeat bosses, and save the New Year in this festive adventure. Dive into quests and bring the Christmas tree home in this exciting online game!

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Stickman Ragdoll Playground
description: Build-A-Flop: The Sickman Playground is not just a game—it's a people's playground of laughter and creativity! With its whimsical world and endless opportunities for hilarity, it's sure to become a favorite among players of all ages.

title: Tony Archer
description:
Evil hooligans have caught your friends, free them quickly and punish the villains!
You are the great Tony Archer, a dude who masterfully handles all types of weapons, can run fast and is a former military man! In his hands, even a stick becomes a deadly weapon! And Tony Archer knows how to stealthily eliminate enemies. Every villain in this city will be punished and all the main character's friends will be saved! Fight on city rooftops, secret laboratories and enemy military complexes.

title: Obby +1 Pet Every Seconds
description:
Are you ready to become the owner of the coolest pet collection? Merge them, upgrade buildings and open new islands!

The game offers you:
- A constant influx of new pets - collect, merge and open rare ones!
- Upgrade your lab, market and home for even more opportunities
- Sell pets, earn money and build your empire

Open all the islands, pump up your pets to the maximum and create your own pet empire in "Obby +1 Pet Every Second"!

title: Brainrot Clicker
description:
Brainrot Clicker is a hilarious and chaotic idle clicker game that plunges you into a bizarre world of meme-fueled madness. Your mission is simple: tap the screen to earn “Italian Brainrot Points” and unlock increasingly ridiculous AI-generated characters from the internet’s wildest corners.

With eye-catching visuals, meme-inspired humor, and endless upgrades, Brainrot Clicker offers a weirdly satisfying experience you won’t want to stop!

title: Arrow Count Master
description: Arrow Count Master is a fast and satisfying runner where every choice changes your firepower. Swipe to move and choose between gates that add, subtract, multiply, or boost your arrows. Build the biggest arrow count possible while avoiding penalties and obstacles along the way.
